scenes.name: 1-transcript
scenes.title: Recordings become readable text
scenes.body: Meetings come back as paragraphs with times, not a wall of short lines.

scenes.name: 2-transcribing
scenes.title: No time limit, no minutes
scenes.body: A 90-minute lecture runs on your own PC, with the time left shown as it goes.

scenes.name: 3-search-export
scenes.title: Search it, save subtitles
scenes.body: Find any word, copy the text, or save it as TXT, SRT or VTT.

scenes.name: 4-queue
scenes.title: Many files, many languages
scenes.body: Queue a folder of files and let the language be detected for each one.
